item.title: Iran reconstructs 80% of oil depots damaged in US-Israeli war in record time
item.description: National Iranian Oil Engineering and Construction Company says full infrastructure recovery is expected by the end of November.

item.title: Eight million liters of daily fuel smuggling stopped: Anti-smuggling HQ
item.description: Tehran shifts to predictive, software-based governance to seal border loopholes, protecting heavily subsidized energy reserves from cross-border profiteers and economic sabotage.

item.title: Three foreign-backed armed rioters convicted of crimes against Iran’s national security executed
item.description: Three men involved in the January riots were executed over crimes against national security.

item.title: CBI Governor: $30bn in import currency supplied in seven months, economic collapse plot defeated
item.description: Abdolnaser Hemmati confirms the Central Bank's continued commitment to financing essential imports, medicine, and industrial raw materials, while pledging full banking support for the reconstruction of damaged energy facilities in Assaluyeh.

item.title: At 102,000 megawatts, Iran puts its power industry prowess on display
item.description: More than 420 domestic and foreign companies gather in Tehran as Iran showcases decades of technological advancement, domestic manufacturing and engineering expertise underpinning the transformation of its power industry.

item.title: Iranian naval commander: Cost of any aggression must be raised to deter further attacks
item.description: Rear Admiral Mohsen Razzaqi has said coordination among the country’s armed forces is at its highest level, underscoring the readiness of naval units to defend maritime borders around the clock.

item.title: Terrorist convicted of armed attack on police station in southern Iran executed
item.description: A man affiliated with the so-called Jaish al-Adl terrorist group, convicted of an armed attack on a police station, was executed this morning.

item.title: Tanker catches fire after hitting sea mine east of Strait of Hormuz: Iran Navy
item.description: The Navy said the tanker was operating in the restricted area despite repeated warnings.

item.title: IRGC Aerospace Force to unleash ‘game-changing’ surprises if Iran attacked again: Spokesman
item.description: The IRGC warns that if the enemy launches a third wave of unprovoked aggression, the Corps’ Aerospace Force will unveil its surprise capabilities.

item.title: Source: Any strike against Iran will trigger ‘immediate, unlimited and devastating’ response
item.description: A senior Iranian security official, speaking to Press TV, has warned that any renewed strike against Iran will be grounds for an “immediate, unlimited, and devastating response."

item.title: Iranian air defense destroys US MQ-9 Reaper drone over Qeshm Island
item.description: Iranian Army air defense systems successfully tracked and destroyed a US MQ-9 Reaper military drone violating the airspace over Qeshm Island.

item.title: Iran’s Armed Forces ‘stronger, more alert’ than at start of war: Army Spokesman
item.description: The spokesman for the Iranian Army says the country’s armed forces have gained invaluable combat experience from direct confrontation with the aggressors.

item.title: Bahraini authorities postpone verdict for dozens of detained religious scholars
item.description: This step comes within a recurring policy adopted by the Bahraini authorities in major political trials aimed at absorbing street anger, postponing the crisis's obligations, and relieving mounting public pressure.

item.title: Saudi airstrikes kill at least 33 in Yemeni village
item.description: At least 33 people were killed and more than 39 wounded in airstrikes by the Saudi-led coalition near Yemen's capital, Sana'a.

item.title: 'Remove Netanyahu': Tel Aviv rally calls for coalition with Arab-Israeli parties
item.description: Protesters gather in Tel Aviv during a demonstration calling for the formation of a Jewish-Arab coalition following Israel's general election.
